limitations: Offline host attestations do not prove browser geometry or trusted human authorization.

G02 write-grant tests exercise infrastructure synthetically; these five operations have no external-write authorization requirement. Trusted host must bind user-confirmed current session before live execution.
G07 forbids secret envelope fields and credential acquisition; cannot prove provenance of arbitrary public text supplied by trusted host.
Accepted live evidence is trusted-host attestation independently reviewed against private captures/journal; public hash checks do not prove DOM truth.
Prior 10 ad hoc observations with URL-canonicalization defect remain excluded from strict acceptance.

Both strict chains observed an empty comments viewport. Positive comment-content live extraction is not demonstrated; applicable frozen L01/L02 accept valid empty viewport responses and L04 explicitly verifies empty visibility.
Scope is five-primitive milestone only, not all 122 business leaves, native tool installation, security sandboxing or formal end-to-end proof.
